test_title: PYST 64: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

CL-FO-IK

EN-HQ-KM
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The first letter of each pair in the triad increases by +3 sequentially, while the second letter of each pair increases by +3 and then decreases by -4.

**For CL-FO-IK →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6640c258702ae68b2490eae4ab696b9c680dc304230dd7361938be2041bd21c0.png] 

 

**For EN-HQ-KM →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf74fccd10595334c7b762e960c1fe1d6b880a1495746b5fd9af9b75eabd95f.png] 

 

**Similarly,Option 1) GP-JS-MO:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beedb7a86f9e89a4bf32d4c8ec07c2b3e32b3d1fda066b9fc93d5a3f70e458e2.png] 

 

Therefore, the triad that follows the same pattern is GP-JS-MO.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
